roles.title: Recruitment Consultant Contract
roles.job_spec:
Recruitment Consultant 360 – Contract





Purpose Of The Role



To generate revenue through contract placements within a defined market.



The Recruitment Consultant is responsible for developing client relationships, sourcing and managing contractors, and delivering successful placements. The role focuses on building a strong contractor network, maintaining consistent pipeline and generating recurring revenue through contractor placements and extensions.





Role Responsibilities



Client Development

• Identify and develop new client relationships within your defined contract market

• Arrange and attend client qualification meetings

• Build long-term relationships that generate repeat contract hiring



Contractor Management

• Source and qualify contractors through multiple channels

• Build talent pools and maintain an active contractor network

• Maintain strong relationships with contractors throughout assignments

• Manage onboarding, extensions and redeployment opportunities



Recruitment Delivery

• Execute the contract recruitment process from qualification through to placement

• Manage interview processes between clients and contractors

• Prepare CVs to agreed company standards

• Maintain strong communication with all parties throughout the process



Market Knowledge

• Develop strong understanding of contractor rates and market trends

• Stay informed on competitor activity and hiring demand

• Position yourself as a credible specialist within your niche



Operational Standards

• Maintain accurate records within Bullhorn / CRM

• Record all conversations and actions with candidates and clients

• Follow company recruitment and compliance processes





What Success Looks Like – How The Role Is Measured



Financial Performance

• Achieving or exceeding revenue targets

• Generating consistent monthly contractor GP



Pipeline & Business Development

• Maintaining a healthy pipeline of contract opportunities

• Building a strong contractor network within your niche

• Generating repeat business from existing clients



Activity & Delivery

• Achieving weekly activity standards

• Consistently sourcing and qualifying contractors

• Progressing interviews and placements through the pipeline



Customer Experience

• Delivering a high-quality experience to both contractors and clients

• Building trust and long-term working relationships



Professional Standards

• Maintaining accurate CRM records

• Following recruitment and compliance processes consistently

• Demonstrating reliability and professionalism





Behaviours & Values Expected In This Role



Consultant level are expected to demonstrate:



Accountability – owning activity, pipeline and revenue generation

Coachability – continuing to develop capability through feedback and learning

Resilience – maintaining consistent performance through rejection and setbacks

Commercial Awareness – understanding the financial impact of recruitment decisions

Professional Conduct – maintaining strong standards with clients, candidates and colleagues



These behaviours form part of probation and promotion assessments.

Recruitment Consultants are also expected to consistently demonstrate our 6 DNA values:

Driven
How much do you want to achieve your goals?

Disciplined
Consistently performing the small actions required to achieve your goals.

Competitive
Self-motivated and driven to continually achieve your best.

Positive
Maintaining a solutions-focused attitude.

Resilient
Bouncing back quickly from setbacks.

Committed
Showing dedication to achieving your goals and contributing to team success.

At Consultant level these values are demonstrated through personal performance, activity discipline and accountability for revenue generation.
